en: The image shows a historical postcard depicting a large, classical-style building with a prominent dome and red roof. There are trees lining the street in front, a horse-drawn carriage, and an early automobile visible, hinting at an early 20th-century setting. The text on the postcard reads 'Cluj' in the upper left, and 'Teologiul reformat – Református teológia' in the upper right, indicating a Reformed (Calvinist) theological institution.
